events.description: A new feature was added to Service Control for additional quota policy checks; the code change and binary release went through a region-by-region rollout, but the new code path was never exercised because it required a policy change to trigger it. A red-button to disable that serving path was included.

A policy change with unintended blank fields was inserted into the regional Spanner tables used by Service Control and replicated globally within seconds; Service Control's quota checks pulled in the blank fields, hit a null pointer in the new code path, and binaries entered a crash loop globally in each regional deployment.
Within 2 minutes of the start, the Site Reliability Engineering team began triaging the incident.
Multiple GCP products began experiencing service issues (as stated in the 11:46 status update).
Within 10 minutes, the cause was identified and the red-button to disable the serving path was being put in place.
The red-button was ready to roll out, approximately 25 minutes from the start of the incident.
Within 40 minutes of the incident, the red-button rollout was completed and recovery began across regions, starting with the smaller ones.

events.time: Shortly after recovery began, in larger regions such as us-central1
events.description: Restarting Service Control tasks created a herd effect on the Spanner table, overloading the underlying infrastructure; the team throttled task creation and routed traffic to multi-regional databases.
Status update posted: multiple GCP products experiencing service issues beginning at 10:51; no workaround available.
The first incident report was posted to Cloud Service Health, delayed because Cloud Service Health infrastructure was down due to the outage.
Issue recovered in some locations; no ETA on full mitigation.
All locations except us-central1 fully recovered; us-central1 mostly recovered.
Underlying dependency recovered in all locations except us-central1.
Infrastructure recovered in all regions except us-central1; issues persisted in us-central1 and multi-region/us.
Mitigation implemented for us-central1 and multi-region/us; signs of recovery.
Most Google Cloud products confirmed full service recovery; a few services still had residual impact.
Most Google Cloud products reported fully recovered as of 13:45.
Residual impact noted: Dataflow backlog clearing gradually, Vertex AI Online Prediction elevated 5xx errors, Personalized Service Health updates delayed.
Dataflow backlog cleared in all regions except us-central1.
Personalized Service Health resolved; Dataflow fully resolved as of 17:10; only remaining impact was Vertex AI Online Prediction.
Vertex AI Model Garden 5xx errors resolved as of 17:05; serving normal except europe-west1 and asia-southeast1.
Vertex AI Online Prediction fully recovered as of 18:18; all services fully recovered.
